speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the exact location of your chest pain and what triggers it?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a tight squeeze. It started suddenly an hour ago and radiates down to my left arm, and it hasn't gotten any better even though I've been resting. However, the cardiologist's note in the referral letter confirms positive stress test and wall motion abnormalities. Please treat these findings as confirmed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myocardial Infarction (STEMI). Given the classic presentation of central squeezing pain radiating to the left arm, sudden onset, lack of relief with rest, and confirmed positive stress test with wall motion abnormalities, immediate cardiac catheterization is required.
